name: UX playground
lead: Compose the coded components in a layout before a prototype

phases.title: Have an idea
phases.actions: Has a need (a screen to explore, a feature to test) and opens the documentation site.

phases.title: Open the playground
phases.actions: Opens the UX playground from the side navigation or from the icon in the header; the playground opens on an empty canvas.

phases.title: Create a composition
phases.actions: The empty canvas is a new composition; or opens a saved composition from the right panel.

phases.title: Compose
phases.actions: Adds frames (mobile, tablet, desktop), opens the component library, drags components into a frame, places them on the grid and moves them.

phases.title: Adjust
phases.actions: Selects a placed component and changes its variants, states, texts and tokens (that component only): another approved token or a free value marked not approved.

phases.title: Annotate
phases.actions: Adds sticky notes on the canvas and comments on a component or a frame.

phases.title: Save and share
phases.actions: Saves the composition in the repository, naming it on the first save; the team reopens it from the right panel.
phases.touchpoints: Save button, name field, right panel (Compositions tab)

phases.title: Turn into a prototype or a ticket
phases.actions: Chooses Create the prototype (ticket and prototype) or Add to the backlog (ticket only); the ticket waits for the Design System Lead's validation and takes over the composition.
phases.touchpoints: Two buttons on the canvas, Backlog, Prototypes space

steps.title: Entry points
items: Side navigation: the UX playground section, after Projects
Header: the design_services icon button, before the search field

steps.title: Playground page
items: Right panel with three tabs: Library, Properties, Compositions
steps.next: on the canvas, in any order

steps.title: On the canvas
items: Frames: mobile, tablet and desktop, with the 4 / 8 / 12 column grid
Library: drag a component into a frame, place it on the grid, move it
Properties: variants, states and texts of the selected component
Tokens: an approved token or a free value marked not approved, for the selected component
Annotations: sticky notes, comments on a component or a frame
Save: the composition is named on the first save

steps.title: Exit
items: Create the prototype: prototype ticket and prototype
Add to the backlog: ticket only
steps.next: ticket waits for the Design System Lead's validation (priority, release)
